rule: D07 terminal-loss stress: every forced exit (a holding sold at its last stored print) is re-marked to ZERO on the day it was booked, pathwise (E'_t = E'_{t-1} (E_t - P_t)/E_{t-1}); "stressed_all" marks every forced exit, "stressed_collapses" only those whose terminal close is below 50% of the trailing-252-session high. Candidate and benchmark are stressed on their OWN forced exits through the identical execution path.
